name: research-canvas
description: Design research modules on a local canvas and discuss saved modules, interface bindings, sources, proposals and code mappings with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Discuss local research designs with Codex
interface.longDescription: Read saved modules from a workspace you explicitly select. Includes a three-layer local design canvas, natural-language flow conditions, interface bindings and shared code mappings. Runs locally with Node.js; does not synchronize chat history.
defaultPrompt: 读取 Research Canvas 中已选择的模块，和我讨论设计、输入输出及实现方案。
